Verified against Figma's Windows shortcuts in the Figma Help Center (help.figma.com, read 2026-10-03):
ADD AUTO LAYOUT Shift+A, REMOVE AUTO LAYOUT Alt+Shift+A: 'Guide to auto layout' / 'Toggle on auto layout in designs'.
WRAP IN FRAME Ctrl+Alt+G, GROUP Ctrl+G: 'The difference between frames and groups'.
ALIGN LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT/TOP/MIDDLE/BOTTOM Alt+A/H/D/W/V/S: 'Adjust alignment, rotation, position, and dimensions'.
CREATE COMPONENT Ctrl+Alt+K: 'Create components to reuse in designs'. DETACH INSTANCE Ctrl+Alt+B: 'Detach an instance from the component'.
COPY / PASTE PROPERTIES Ctrl+Alt+C / Ctrl+Alt+V: 'Copy and paste properties between layers'.
RENAME Ctrl+R: 'Rename Layers'. RUN LAST PLUGIN Ctrl+Alt+P: 'Use plugins in files'.
Search (GO TO MAIN, RESET INSTANCE) Ctrl+K: 'Use the actions menu in Figma Design'.
Knob zoom Ctrl+scroll: 'Adjust your zoom and view options'. F2 Enter / Shift+Enter (child / parent): 'Select layers and objects'.
Unverified (default mapping kept): TIDY UP Ctrl+Alt+T; F1 undo / redo Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z; F2 tap Shift+2; F4 N / Shift+N (next / previous frame).
